correctness_confidence.basis: Formal verification in Lean 4.35.0 (18 zero-sorry, zero-Classical.choice theorems) and exact rational Q/Z verification (POLY-DECOMP-CERT-1.0) with 60/60 red-team rejections.

novelty.basis: First standalone formalization and exact certificate verifier for Keevash and Lim's 2026 breakthrough on polynomial decomposition and discrete tomography reconfiguration.

reproducibility.basis: Complete standalone codebases in Lean 4 and Python with 16 canonical certificates, verifiable end-to-end via verify_all.py and SHA-256 manifests.

rigor.basis: Exhaustive verification of algebraic invariants, witness families, cyclotomic factorizations, and Legendre slice integrals with strict type checking and zero floats.

significance.basis: Bridges advanced algebraic combinatorics (Legendre cross-polytope slice integrals, m-basic polynomials) with machine-checked theorem proving and exact certification.

strengths: Exact rational Q/Z certificate verifier POLY-DECOMP-CERT-1.0 with zero floats
Comprehensive red-team audit with 60/60 adversarial forgeries rejected
Clean reproducibility across 16 canonical certificates and SHA-256 manifests
strong_novelty_candidates: Standalone zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization of Legendre slice integrals and discrete tomography reconfiguration
summary: The paper presents a rigorous, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization and exact Python Q/Z certificate verifier for Keevash and Lim's recent breakthrough on polynomial decompositions, discrete tomography reconfiguration, and Legendre cross-polytope slice integrals.
weaknesses: Relies on external foundational paper arXiv:2611.33120 for broader algorithmic context
Asymptotic random-walk mixing bounds are excluded from formalization scope
